what.question: What is ChainUp AI Agent?
what.answer: An exchange-native AI agent that lets Coobit users query markets, inspect sub-account balances, and submit orders through natural language in Telegram — within the frozen API capability matrix.

subaccount.question: Why a dedicated Agent sub-account?
subaccount.answer: Trading capital and token billing are isolated from your main ledger. You authorize creation via exchange deeplink; the agent never moves funds without explicit rules and your confirmation on writes.

confirm.question: What is Type A confirmation?
confirm.answer: Every write path (orders, cancels, config changes) surfaces a Telegram card you must tap to confirm before the exchange receives the request. No silent writes.

billing.question: How does token billing work?
billing.answer: Usage-based token fees deduct from your Agent sub-account USDT balance. View statements through the exchange billing deeplink — not inside Telegram text alone.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: Open Agent settings on Coobit (me/agent), authorize the sub-account, complete API binding, then follow the Telegram deeplink to bind your chat. VIP tier requirements apply.

safe.question: Is my account safe?
safe.answer: The agent uses sub-account isolation, confirm-before-write gates, and audit trails. Crypto trading carries risk — never allocate more than you can afford to lose. Capabilities match the published API matrix only.
